title: Neighbor Crowding Predicts Feature Stability in Sparse Autoencoders
abstract: arXiv:2611.33182v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) offer an approach to identify language model representations by breaking apart polysemantic features into more sparse, interpretable ones. Yet, it is challenging to identify which of the learned features are actually stable, rather than artifacts of initialization. One approach is to train multiple SAE seeds, and compare the learned features across seeds by cosine similarity, but this is notably costly. This raises the question of whether stable features can be identified without the computational expense of training multiple seeds. In this work, we examine cross-seed feature stability across differing levels of training tokens, and demonstrate that in TopK SAEs, it is highly predictable using six computationally cheap statistics derived from a single training run. Neighbor crowding, a geometric property of the dictionary, is the strongest single predictor, with features that sit in dense regions of the unit

translated_title: 稀疏自编码器中的邻域拥挤度可预测特征稳定性
translated_abstract: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）提供了一种识别语言模型表征的方法，通过将多义特征分解为更稀疏、更可解释的特征来实现。然而，要识别哪些学习到的特征是真正稳定的、而非初始化产生的伪影，仍然颇具挑战。一种方法是对多个随机种子分别训练SAE，再通过余弦相似度比较不同种子学习到的特征，但这种方法的计算成本相当高。由此引出一个问题：能否在不付出训练多个种子所需计算开销的情况下识别稳定特征。在这项工作中，我们考察了不同训练token数量水平下的跨种子特征稳定性，并证明在TopK SAE中，仅凭从单次训练中获得的六个计算代价低廉的统计量，就能对这种稳定性进行高度准确的预测。其中，邻域拥挤度——字典的一种几何性质——是最强的单一预测因子，位于单位球面上密集区域的特征……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该研究发现在TopK稀疏自编码器中，特征的跨种子稳定性仅凭单次训练得到的六个低成本统计量即可高度预测，其中字典的几何性质“邻域拥挤度”是最强预测因子，从而无需昂贵的多种子训练便能识别稳定特征。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that cross-seed feature stability in TopK sparse autoencoders is highly predictable from a single training run using six computationally cheap statistics—most notably "neighbor crowding," a geometric property of the dictionary—eliminating the need for costly multi-seed training.
